Metadata.title: Juntly — Local services, real skills
Metadata.description: Find local people and services near you. Juntly brings communities, customers and trusted providers closer together.

Landing.heading: Local services, closer to home.
Landing.description: A simple way to find people with real skills in your community — starting in rural Portugal.
